'''Asa-Ku''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. A member of the [[Dream-walkers]] sub-sect of [[Voss Mystics]], he was in the [[Mind healer's grove]] around [[3640 BBY]] , where he was approached by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], who looking for the information on the [[Forbidden Ritual]]. Asa-Ku agreed to share the secret on the condition that the Sith join the order of the dream-walkers.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Asa-Ku appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Voss.<ref name="SWTOR" />
